common_causes.label: Vacuum leak (intake manifold, hoses, brake booster)

characteristic_signatures.vacuum_leak: Fuel trims rise with load; MAF reads low but tracks RPM/load smoothly with consistent proportional offset; no erratic spikes.
characteristic_signatures.maf_fault: MAF readings erratic with high variance and occasional wild spikes; MAF does not correlate smoothly with RPM/load; coefficient of variation of MAF residuals is much higher than a healthy sensor.
characteristic_signatures.weak_fuel_delivery: Trims go NEGATIVE at high load; fuel pressure drops under demand.
characteristic_signatures.ignition_fault: Misfires concentrated on specific cylinders; trims near normal.
characteristic_signatures.o2_sensor_fault: O2 voltage flatlined while trims show active closed-loop correction.

available_tests.label: Smoke machine intake test for vacuum leaks
